Copenhagen.name: Dansborg Hallen
Copenhagen.recommended_hardness_notes: Venue is hardwood floor with a smattering of Handball resin.

Utrecht.name: Disaster Dome
Utrecht.recommended_hardness_notes: The floor is hard plastic (over top of concrete), smooth. Can be slippery in damp weather. No AC, temp is same as outside (or worse).

Köln.name: Montessori-Gymnasium Köln
Köln.recommended_hardness_notes: Sticky sportshall floor. Venue is in a residential area, there are a few parking spots in side streets.

Eindhoven.name: RC de Lichtstad
Eindhoven.recommended_hardness_notes: Our venue has a very smooth, concrete floor. 84-92A wheels are advised. We recommend not leaving any valuables in the changing room. We recommend wearing flip-flops in the shower.
